description: Get the core Chinese words for a topic such as food, family, travel or business, with pinyin, meaning and HSK level. Call it with no topic to list the 30 topics and their slugs. Use this when the user wants words for a situation or subject. Do not use it to translate a specific word.

topic.description: A topic slug such as food. Omit to list all topics.

name: get_topic_words
title: Chinese vocabulary by topic
